create_RunThroughCorridor_task: create a RunThroughCorridor task with a walker and arena to run a corridor locomotion experiment
initialize_episode_mjcf: initialize the MJCF model for a corridor episode by regenerating the arena and setting camera bounds
initialize_episode: initialize an episode by reinitializing the walker pose and computing non-foot geom IDs for contact detection
get_reward: get the reward for a corridor episode based on the walker forward velocity relative to the target velocity
should_terminate_episode: check if the corridor episode should terminate due to disallowed contact or end effector height failure
